name: MODP
description: Modular-arithmetic group complex for grokking (方案 A). 11 vertices: 10 are views of an ordered pair (a,b) mod p under 12 real operations, plus a control vertex X that is only ever reached by the memorisation-only placebo edge P_X (a genuine P->X edge, not a self-loop); 3 faces are equality-comparison identities (a-b=a+(-b), a+b=b+a, a/b=a*b^-1). Every real edge and face is trained on 40% of Zp x Zp (shared split, closed under negate-2nd/swap/invert-2nd so Pn_D/Ps_S/Pi_Q cannot leak) and probed on the held-out 60%: 'latent cell birth' here means the held-out accuracy of a *taught* edge/face crossing threshold (grokking), not a structurally untrained edge as in RCN12.
